layers.heading: Layers
layers.hint: One color layer at a time. Intensity follows the indicator value; broader levels stay as outlines.

legend.fallback: No finer data; keeping the {level} level.
legend.ec02: Real data: SII F2890, deeds {from}–{to}. All property types, no floor area.
legend.in04: Real data: DTPM GTFS, weekday 7–9 am, stops within 500 m straight line. Zones without buildings shown faint.
legend.in01: Real data: Overture Maps and DTPM GTFS. Grocery, pharmacy, primary care and transit; 100 = all within 5 min, 0 = 20+ min. Minutes estimated from straight-line distance.
legend.so01: Real data: INE Census 2024 by block. Residents per km² of each cell; for the comuna, the density the average resident lives at (empty hills don't dilute it).

drawer.label: Selected place card
drawer.demoNote: Sale prices, transit and daily services are real data; other values in this build are synthetic. Comuna geometries are real.
drawer.teaserTitle: The information. And what it means.
drawer.teaserText: Estimated value, records, surroundings and priority checks in a single report.
drawer.method_EC02: SII form F2890 (registered transfers). Sales from 500 to 100,000 UF; a deal covering several rols (apartment + parking + storage) counts once. No type or floor area until the SII catastro is joined.
drawer.method_IN04: DTPM GTFS (Red Metropolitana de Movilidad). Weekday 7–9 am departures per hour at stops and stations within 500 m straight line of the zone center; not walking time over streets. Comuna: zone average weighted by building count (Overture).
drawer.accNote: Estimated minutes: straight line ×1.3 at 4.5 km/h, not an actual route.
drawer.method_IN01: Overture Maps (places with confidence ≥0.5) and DTPM GTFS stops. Four equally weighted groups: grocery, pharmacy, primary care, transit; score 100 at ≤5 min, 0 at ≥20 min. Minutes estimated from straight-line distance ×1.3 at 4.5 km/h. Measures distance, not service quality.
drawer.method_SO01: INE Census 2024 block cartography (n_per). Each block is assigned to the ~600 m cell containing its center; gross density = residents / cell area. Comuna value: population-weighted mean of cell densities. Cells without residents have no value.

partners.agenciesText: Report packs, batch requests and client delivery from one workspace.

methods.title: Clear data. Clear conclusions.
methods.lead: Every indicator keeps its source, date, scale and status: observed, documented or estimated.
methods.aText: Available detail varies by place and indicator. A comuna-level figure keeps that scope on a property card.
methods.bText: Estimates come with their method and limits. Missing information stays visible.
methods.cText: The report brings together evidence, calculations and analysis. Checks that need documents or a visit are marked explicitly.
methods.dText: Each source's date accompanies the indicator. Historical versions are kept apart from current observations.
